02_About_Heading: I am Mukeshi Martin, the eye behind Keshphotography.
02_About_Body: I am a photographer, filmmaker and media consultant based in Nairobi. For years I have been capturing people, places and stories across Kenya and beyond, from weddings and corporate events to documentary and travel films. My approach is simple: real moments over stiff poses, and images built to do a job, whether that is filling a feed, launching a brand or keeping a memory.
